title: Motion design system sizzle — video poster

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Give a motion presentation a simple recognizable signature before its examples begin.
strategic_value: The gradient and wordmark can establish Instagram identity with few elements.
demonstration: The supplied Vimeo poster centers a white Instagram wordmark over a full-spectrum gradient. The sizzle video was not retrieved.
practical_value: Read this as a title treatment; the still cannot establish the video’s motion behavior.

content_islands.spec: Fill the landscape field with the smooth multicolor gradient.

content_islands.name: Wordmark
content_islands.spec: Center the white Instagram name with generous surrounding space.
